Activepieces co-founder: 'we chose pricing on step execution to easily compare with Zapier and Make.' Free tier compared as: activepieces - free / 5000 tasks / month vs zapier 100 tasks/month, make 1000 ops/month.

Followed the instructions to run it locally, found a bug: can't send an http get request without a body; docker-compose file doesn't run local code, just pulls published images, and dev setup instructions are missing.

My biggest concern with these zapier alternatives is how easy is it to add an integration for services that aren't already in the system... Is there good documentation for this? A boilerplate 'new plugin' setup so I can add my own?

How does this relate to Automatisch, if at all? The frontend, documentation, and codebase have eerie similarities to ActivePieces.
